Simplify Consent Management with Enhanced Control, Validation, and Transparency

Conversive introduces an enhanced

Consent Management

experience that gives organizations greater control over customer consent preferences, collection, validation, and reporting. With configurable consent scopes, form-based consent capture, CSV validation and export, improved consent resolution, and accessible consent history, businesses can manage consent records more consistently. The enhancements also support customer-initiated consent updates and provide standardized Voice Consent Capture settings.

What's New

\\*

Configurable Consent Scope:

Define consent scope parameters to control how customer consent preferences are applied. Restricted consent scope preferences can no longer be edited by users.

\\*

Form-Based Consent Capture:

Capture customer consent directly through forms for a simpler and more consistent collection process.

\\*

Consent Record Validation:

Validate consent records in CSV files to identify invalid or inconsistent data.

\\*

Consent Data Export:

Download consent records in CSV format, including the configured consent parameters, for reporting and analysis.

\\*

Enhanced Consent Resolution:

Benefit from improved consent resolution to ensure consent updates are handled consistently.

\\*

Accessible Consent History:

View consent history details directly through the three-dot menu without needing to hover over it.

\\*

Customer-Initiated Consent Updates:

Support consent updates initiated by end customers to help keep their preferences current.

\\*

Standardized Voice Consent Settings:

Access a normalized Voice Consent Capture section for a more consistent configuration experience.

\\*

Flexible Consent Scope Options:

Configure consent based on the following combinations:

\\*

Subscriber + Channel:

Consent based on the mobile number and communication channel, such as SMS or WhatsApp.

\\*

Subscriber + Sender ID:

Consent based on the mobile number and Sender ID.

\\*

Subscriber + Channel + Sender ID:

Consent based on the mobile number, communication channel, and Sender ID.

Steps to Configure

1. Navigate to
Consent Management
    settings in Conversive.
2. Configure the required
consent scope parameters
    and review the available consent preferences.
3. Use forms to capture customer consent and support customer-initiated updates where available.
4. Validate consent records when working with CSV files to identify invalid or inconsistent entries.
5. Download consent records in CSV format, including the configured consent parameters, for reporting or review.
6. Open the
three-dot menu
    to access and review consent history details.
7. Navigate to
Settings
    and review the
Voice Consent Capture
    section to configure the available voice consent options.

Who Benefits

\\*

Administrators:

Configure consent scopes, manage preferences, and control access to restricted consent settings.

\\*

Compliance Teams:

Review consent records, validate CSV data, and access consent history for better visibility.

\\*

Marketing Teams:

Capture and manage customer consent across communication channels and Sender IDs.

\\*

Customer Support Teams:

Access consent history and support customer-initiated preference updates.

\\*

Operations Teams:

Manage consent records more consistently through improved resolution, validation, and export capabilities.

Optimize SaaS Campaign Auto Recharge with Estimated Credit Calculations

Conversive enhances Auto Recharge for SaaS Campaigns with estimated-credit-based recharge calculations. This improvement helps businesses anticipate campaign credit requirements, plan recharges more effectively, and maintain sufficient credits for campaign execution while reducing the need for manual intervention.

What's New

\\*

Estimated Credit-Based Calculations:

Auto Recharge now calculates recharge requirements based on estimated credits for SaaS Campaigns.

\\*

Improved Recharge Planning:

Estimate the credit requirements before campaign processing to support better recharge planning.

\\*

Campaign Readiness:

Help ensure sufficient credits are available for campaign execution.

\\*

Reduced Manual Intervention:

Support proactive credit management through automated recharge calculations.

Who Benefits

\\*

Campaign Managers:

Better anticipate credit requirements and maintain campaign readiness.

\\*

Marketing Teams:

Plan campaign execution with improved visibility into estimated credit consumption.

\\*

Finance and Operations Teams:

Support proactive recharge planning and reduce manual credit management.

\\*

SaaS Administrators:

Benefit from automated recharge calculations based on estimated campaign credits.

Optimize Zoho Bulk Messaging with Estimated-Credit-Based Auto Recharge

Conversive enhances Auto Recharge for Zoho bulk messaging with estimated-credit-based recharge calculations. This improvement helps businesses anticipate the credit requirements of bulk messaging operations, plan recharges more effectively, and maintain sufficient credits for planned messaging activities while reducing the need for manual monitoring.

What's New

\\*

Estimated-Credit-Based Calculations:

Auto Recharge for Zoho bulk messaging now calculates recharge requirements based on estimated credits.

\\*

Improved Credit Planning:

Align recharge requirements with the expected credit consumption of bulk messaging operations.

\\*

Uninterrupted Messaging:

Help maintain sufficient credits for planned bulk messaging activities.

\\*

Reduced Manual Monitoring:

Make it easier to anticipate and plan credit requirements before initiating bulk messaging.

Who Benefits

\\*

Marketing Teams:

Plan bulk messaging campaigns with better visibility into estimated credit requirements.

\\*

Campaign Managers:

Anticipate credit consumption before initiating bulk messaging activities.

\\*

Operations Teams:

Reduce manual credit monitoring and support uninterrupted messaging operations.

\\*

Administrators:

Benefit from more proactive credit management through estimated-credit-based recharge calculations.

Sync Corefactors Messages with Corresponding Lead Records in Conversive

Conversive now supports synchronizing messages with their corresponding lead records in Corefactors CRM. This enhancement brings messaging information closer to lead details, helping teams maintain visibility into customer interactions, access relevant conversation context, and support more informed lead follow-ups.

What's New

\\*

Message Synchronization with Lead Records:

Sync Corefactors messages with their corresponding lead records.

\\*

Improved Lead Visibility:

Access relevant messaging information directly alongside lead details.

\\*

Centralized Customer Interactions:

Keep message activity associated with the relevant lead for easier reference.

\\*

Better Follow-Up Context:

Review messaging information while managing and engaging with leads.

Steps to Configure

1. Ensure that the
Corefactors CRM integration
    is configured and connected in Conversive.
2. Open the relevant
Lead record
    in Corefactors.
3. Verify that the associated messages are synchronized and available on the lead record.

Who Benefits

\\*

Sales Teams:

Access messaging context directly from lead records to support informed customer engagement.

\\*

Lead Management Teams:

Review associated message activity while managing lead information.

\\*

Customer Support Teams:

Reference relevant messaging interactions when following up with leads.

\\*

CRM Administrators:

Benefit from better association of messaging information with corresponding Corefactors lead records.

Simplify Notification Automation with Flexible Trigger Conditions

Conversive introduces flexible trigger configuration for Notification UseCases, allowing users to choose whether notifications should execute with or without conditions. This enhancement simplifies notification setup, supports immediate and delayed message delivery, and enables Journey-based execution without duplicating condition logic. Existing notifications with configured conditions continue to work as before.

What's New

\\*

Trigger Without Conditions:

Create and activate notifications without configuring property or value conditions. Notifications set to trigger immediately can fire as soon as a contact is created in the Audience Manager.

\\*

Trigger With Conditions:

Configure specific properties and values to determine when a notification should fire. The notification is triggered only when the defined condition is met.

\\*

Support for Wait Periods:

Configure wait periods for notifications that do not have conditions.

\\*

Multiple Messages:

Use

Add Another Message

with notifications configured without conditions.

\\*

Journey-Aware Execution:

Notifications added as Journey steps execute when the Journey reaches the Notification step, using the selected trigger mode.

\\*

Reuse Journey Conditions:

Rely on conditions already configured in the Journey without defining the same conditions again within the Notification.

\\*

Optional Conditions:

Create and activate notifications without configuring any conditions.

\\*

Backward Compatibility:

Existing notifications retain their configured conditions and continue to function as before.

Steps to Configure

1. Open an existing
Notification
    automation or create a new one.
2. Select the required trigger mode:

\\*

Without Condition:

Choose this option to trigger the notification immediately or after a configured wait period, without defining property or value conditions.

\\*

With Condition:

Choose this option and specify the property and value that must be met before the notification fires.

3. To use the notification within a Journey, add it as a
Notification step
    in the Journey.
4. Configure the required message and wait period, if applicable.
5. Save and activate the Notification.

Who Benefits

\\*

Marketing Teams:

Create and activate notifications with simpler trigger configurations for customer communication.

\\*

Campaign Managers:

Configure immediate or delayed notifications without defining unnecessary conditions.

\\*

Journey Builders:

Reuse existing Journey conditions instead of duplicating the same logic within individual notifications.

\\*

Automation Administrators:

Manage notification trigger behavior with greater flexibility while retaining existing configurations.

\\*

Customer Engagement Teams:

Reduce configuration complexity and support more consistent notification execution.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lrGb62_lk8I)

Customize Incoming-Message Sound Notifications in Conversive Unified Desk

Conversive Unified Desk now allows users to disable sound notifications for incoming messages through Account Settings. This enhancement gives users greater control over their audio notification preferences, helping reduce distractions, maintain focus on ongoing conversations, and personalize their working experience based on individual preferences and work environments.

What's New

\\*

Control Incoming-Message Sounds:

Users can disable the sound played when incoming messages arrive in Unified Desk.

\\*

Personalized Audio Preferences:

Manage audio notification preferences based on individual working styles and communication needs.

\\*

Reduced Audio Distractions:

Minimize interruptions from repeated incoming-message sounds.

\\*

Improved Work Focus:

Continue managing conversations and tasks with fewer audio distractions.

Steps to Configure

1. Open
Unified Desk
.
2. Navigate to
Account Settings
.
3. Locate the
Incoming-Message Sound
    option.
4. Disable the sound option to stop audio alerts for incoming messages.

Who Benefits

\\*

Contact Center Agents:

Reduce audio interruptions while handling ongoing customer conversations.

\\*

Customer Support Teams:

Maintain focus while managing multiple customer interactions.

\\*

Sales Teams:

Personalize notification preferences while handling customer communications.

\\*

Unified Desk Users:

Customize their audio notification experience according to their working environment and preferences.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YLDLKA2Laww)
